title: GreatWorks
description: A list of Great Works: art, artifacts, literature and music that Great People create, archaeologists dig up or buildings come with.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the Great Work.

type.title: Type
type.description: Art and Artifact share one kind of slot, Literature and Music each have their own.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: The name of the Great Person that creates this work, a name from a unit name group.

era.title: Era
era.description: For artifacts: the era this artifact is specific to.

artifactClass.title: Artifact Class
artifactClass.description: For artifacts: what kind of find it is.

archaeologyOnly.title: Archaeology Only
archaeologyOnly.description: A work that only archaeologists can find, which no Great Person creates.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: A quote to show with the work.
